qa_pairs.question: Which pin number corresponds to the oil stat signal?
What are the wire colors for the injection signal (TI)?
What is the difference between pin 6 and pin 7 functions?
qa_pairs.answer: Pin 6 (15 S) is voltage with ignition on with fuse protection, while pin 7 (15 U) is the same as pin 6 but lead without fuse

qa_pairs.question: What wire color indicates the burglar alarm signal?
Which pin is designated for the fault display and what models is it for?
qa_pairs.answer: Pin 12 (CARB) for fault display, only for US models

qa_pairs.question: What are the wire colors for the self-diagnosis transmitting lead (RXD)?
How many total pins are shown in this engine plug connection diagram?
What is the function of pin 19 and what are its wire colors?
qa_pairs.answer: Pin 19 (Oeltemp) is for oil temperature sensor with brown/violet wire colors
